7.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
7.description:
NEW: Holy Ascension- After casting Holy Fire your next spell is empowered:
Smite: Deals 50% additional damage.
Exorcism: Increases all Holy damage you deal to the target by 5% for 10 seconds.
Penance: Fires an additional holy bolt.
Holy Shock: Guaranteed to critically strike.

7.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
7.description:
NEW: Blademaster- When you parry you gain 150 armor for 20 seconds, stacking 5 times. At 5 stacks you empower the next ability you use, consuming the stacks and granting it an additional effect for 10 seconds:

Devastate: Deals 50% additional damage and reduces the targets armor by an additional 10% for 6 seconds.

Riposte: Increases your chance to parry by 12% for 12 seconds.

Shield Slam: Attempts to dispel 1 additional effect from the target and increases your block value by 10% for 12 seconds.

7.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
7.description: Swift Spells now also triggers from direct healing spells.

5.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
5.description: The Warrior AQ20 set bonus has been reworked to: Berserker Rage now also increases the damage you deal by 5% and reduces the damage you take by 5%.

5.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
5.description: The Warlock AQ20 set bonus has been reworked to: Your Corruption spell grants you a Soul Sliver when it deals damage. Soul Sliver grants you 5 spell power for 12 seconds and stacks up to 8 times. At 8 stacks the stacks are consumed and your next Shadow Bolt within 10 seconds will deal 50% additional damage (20% to players).

5.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
5.description:
The Shaman AQ20 set bonus has been reworked to: You gain an additional effect when using your Call of spells:

Call of the Elements- Increases your spell power by 30 for 2 min.

Call of the Ancestors- Increases your attack power by 60 for 2 min.

Call of the Spirits- Increase your spell haste by 2% and grants you 21 mp5 for 2 min.

You may not have more than 1 of these effects active at a time.

5.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
5.description: The Rogue AQ20 set bonus has been reworked to: Increases your energy regeneration by 12%.

5.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
5.description: The Priest AQ20 set bonus has been reworked to: Reduces the cooldown of your Penance by 2 seconds, Circle of Healing by 1.5 seconds, and Mind Blast by 2 seconds.

5.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
5.description: The Paladin AQ20 set bonus has been reworked to: Casting Judgement increases your Strength by 20 and Spell Power by 30 for 8 seconds.

5.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
5.description: The Mage AQ20 set bonus has been reworked to: Arcane Power now reduces the mana cost of your spells instead by 20%, increases the critical strike damage bonus of Combustion by 20%, and increase the duration of both Icy Veins effects by 20% seconds.

5.author: Perth(214980069209145345)
5.description:
The Druid AQ20 set bonus has been reworked to: Gain the following bonuses based on your Shapeshift form:

Bear: Reduces all damage taken by 3%.

Cat: Increases critical strike damage by 5%.

Moonkin: Increases the critical strike chance of Wrath by 5% and reduces the cast time of Starfire by 5%.

Tree of Life: Healing Touch criticals extend the duration of your Rejuvenation spell by 3 seconds and refund 50% of the spells cost.
